kubeconfig: <scratch>/kubeconfig (exported for every kubectl, kind and make call)

tool_versions.docker_builder: legacy builder (buildx not installed), the same path the Makefile's docker build takes

concurrency_note: run concurrently with up to 4 other kind clusters on the same host; host load sampled every 10 s in ../host-load/host_load.csv
live_change_statement: The only live change made to the lab was the vending-service Deployment's image (kubectl set image to nhi-lab/vending-service:falsify-gN, then back to nhi-lab/vending-service:dev, the clean image loaded at bring-up and never rebuilt). It was restored after every guard and the running imageID was confirmed equal to the baseline each time. No ConfigMap, env, Secret or manifest was changed; REAPER_INTERVAL stayed 15s and MAX_LIVE_CHILDREN 8 (final-live-state.log). Lab-API calls beyond the suite: two DELETE /delegations disposals via parentsim (cleanup of delegations a mutation had wrongly minted, as the procedure allows) and read-only GETs, x509-checks, SPIRE entry show, kubectl logs, and one read of audit.jsonl from the kind node's local-path volume.

isolation.mutated_images: only nhi-lab/vending-service:falsify-g1..g5, built from <scratch>/vs-gN, loaded only into nhi-t-falsify
isolation.dev_images: never built, tagged or retagged by this stream outside install.sh's own clean build from the unmodified worktree
isolation.make: only via install.sh (bash, no -j) against the clean worktree; no make target was run against a mutated tree

commands_not_individually_timed: Inside <scratch>/bin/live.sh: pod_info/running_image_id (kubectl get pods), snapshot (spire-server entry show, parentsim get), and kubectl logs of the vending-service pod after each suite run, all read-only. They ran inside the windows of the live-*, set-image-* and rollout-status-* commands; their outputs are rollout-*.log, state-*.log and vs-podlog-*.log.
Child-pod x509-check polls after each cleanup (timestamped per line in cleanup-g1.log and cleanup-g2.log).
Read-only checks of the kind worker node (ls /var/log/pods, ls /var/local-path-provisioner) at about 02:21-02:26Z before evidence-durable-audit-copy.
Local jq/grep extraction over files already in <scratch>, versions.txt collection at about 02:09Z, and git status checks of the worktree.
deviations: Reverted runs for g1 and g2 failed on the first attempt because of state the mutated run left behind; per procedure they were cleaned up through the vending service's DELETE and rerun once. Both attempts are kept, as live-gN-reverted-attempt1/-attempt2.
For g4 the mutation replaces the call with error(nil) inside the existing if header rather than deleting a statement; the behaviour is the same.

Evidence additions beyond the requested files: state-*.log snapshots, vs-podlog-*.log (g4 and g5 only; the capture was added after g3), build/load logs, and vending-audit-durable.log. That last file is audit.jsonl read with docker exec cat from this stream's own kind worker node, the only way to recover the g1-g3 mutated pods' audit events without starting the make vending-audit reader pod.
